title: We made a game where you pack Tetris-shaped parcels onto fish, and it's releasing in 2 weeks!
author: Delicious-Score6250
selftext:
Hey everyone!

We, a small indie team, and our game Undersea Post Office is coming out in just 2 weeks!

We had this weird little idea: What if the entire world was underwater, fish became delivery workers, and you had to pack their cargo like a game of Tetris?

So we actually made it!

You run a small underwater post office, weigh packages, calculate shipping fees, and then try to fit all those oddly shaped parcels into the limited cargo space carried by your fish couriers.

We've spent months bringing this idea to life, and now that release is getting close, we're honestly both excited and terrified.

We know it's a pretty unusual concept, but we hope fellow Tetris lovers might enjoy this little twist on fitting shapes together.

🎬 Trailer: https://youtu.be/\\\_3AHRlLE8HQ

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5179790/Undersea\\\_Post\\\_Office\\\_Sim/

Would you play a game where your Tetris skills help fish deliver mail?
